metadata.title: ULTIMATE Food & Travel Series of VIDARBHA in Maharashtra I Best FOOD of Nagpur + Amravati & Yavatmal
metadata.description:
We recently embarked on an immersive culinary exploration across the cities of Nagpur, Amravati and Yavatmal in the Vidarbha region of Maharashtra to discover the quintessential flavours and food traditions of these places. From irresistible street food to soulful regional cuisines and fascinating food stories to unique food traditions, this gastronomic journey was truly magical. Presenting you a glimpse of this remarkable journey across this region renowned for historical heritage and natural beauty. 


SERIES BEGINNING FROM 27TH MAY, 2023.
STAY TUNED!! 



About the host:
https://anubhavsapra.com/
**For more such fascinating culinary explorations and stories do subscribe to our channel and follow us on - 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/delhifoodwalks
Twitter: https://twitter.com/delhifoodwalks
Instagram: https://instagram.com/delhifoodwalks

Design and filmed by Rahul Singh 
https://www.instagram.com/iamrahulsin...

Text by Swetaleena Nayak
